modelNotes: 2026-09-25 decision: all GAIN factors set to 1 (B-003)
2026-09-25 decision: per-collective cost floor OPT.tauUs = 1.15 us, the spec basis (ADR-0004, B-008); booked as services.tauFloor
2026-09-25: the previously published 681.06 TPS candidate is added as a search seed (PUBLISHED_SEEDS)

2026-09-25: compute/collective overlap (OPT.commOverlap) -- COMM runs on its own lane; only the data-independent shared experts are issued under the Wdown + Router all-gather; raw = compute + comm + wait - overlap

2026-09-25: separate TMA lanes (OPT.tmaLane) -- the DMA-sourced shared->local fill of each op is booked as services.tmaFill and issued ahead of the op on a per-domain (L/H) lane into the free local double-buffer half once its shared-SRAM inputs are ready; it shares the shared-SRAM read port and fabric with DMA/ops/collectives and the local write port with a same-domain kernel; the hidden part is services.tmaHidden; raw = compute - tmaHidden + comm + wait - overlap

2026-09-25: cross-layer KV prefetch (OPT.kvPrefetch=window) -- KV context tiles of the next overlapDepth layers are DMA candidates like weights (past-token KV does not depend on the current token), bounded by shared-SRAM capacity

2026-09-25: DMA preemption (OPT.dmaPreempt) -- DMA is striped, so the routed-expert demand fetch released by Top-k, or any fetch the next op needs, parks an in-flight prefetch (which keeps its SRAM reservation and resumes in consumer order) instead of queueing behind a multi-MB KV tile; prediction accuracy (0.8) is unchanged
2026-09-25 decision: reference-393 basis accepted (B-007); the folded Wup + Shared output all-reduce now follows the shared-expert compute

launch batching applied once with launchScale (was applied twice: 0.45 then 0.55 with an ad-hoc subtraction)
shared-SRAM port scaling charged as bank area and port power (chargeSharedPortCost) and re-checked against die/card limits
